ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels, estimated at <0.05, representing localized scarring against a dominant dark substrate.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pixel mass covering approximately 95% of the visible surface. High-contrast white pixel clusters and individual points are scattered non-uniformly, with higher density in the medial region and along the distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated depth of approximately 45 pixels relative to the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits fine-grained, high-frequency serrations. Left lobe displays macro-level irregular indentations, specifically two large U-shaped notches located approximately 40% and 60% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips, with the left tip showing a more pronounced vertical uplift than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (diameter 3-10 pixels) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, white linear pixel disruptions (varying lengths from 15 to 80 pixels) distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of 3D-textured, high-relief brown/white pixel masses (barnacle colonization) present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; significant trailing edge loss/notch on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density barnacle clusters creating a jagged, non-linear pixel boundary at the distal outer margins.
